unit.why: This is the end of the author's personal preface or plea, signed 'אברהם יוסף בן לאה'. It cites a teaching on exile and a short saying of R. Yaakov Zvi of Parysów, framed only by 'he said to a hasid who came to him the first time', so it has no real narrative.
unit.boundary_note: division begins mid-sentence ('לצדיקים שגולין...'), continuing the preface from the previous division; next division is a memorial dedication
